page.overview:
What is Area of Inaccessibility?

Area of Inaccessibility is a major location in the 1994 James Bond comic Shattered Helix. It was a CIA-owned biochemical weapons development lab-complex situated at Antarctica, where the organization gathered all of the best in the field to try create the ultimate biochemical weapon.

It is the site of the final conflict in the Shattered Helix story-line, where the Cerberus organization tries to acquire the research within it.

Five years before the events of Shattered Helix, CIA had the Area of Inaccessibility constructed in the Antarctica. Subsequently, a group of researchers, including Professor Boyce, was brought there to study various diseases. The goal was to create a viral weapon, which could be programmed to cause specific diseases on its targets.

Despite not creating this programmable virus, they created a mutagen, which Prof. Boyce deemed too dangerous to exist, yet beyond his ability to destroy. As such, he engineered an accident, which caused the laboratory complex to be abandoned. Subsequently, after all return to United States, Boyce's fellow scientists would die to variety of diseases, leaving him the only survivor.
